name: slopsentral
description: Source contracts and validation tooling for the Slopsentral plugin marketplace

scripts.check:evals: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- sh -c "tsc --project tools/promptfoo/tsconfig.json && node --test tools/tests/promptfoo-*.test.mjs && npm run eval:skills:smoke"
scripts.check:source: node tools/validate-source-graph.mjs && node tools/catalog.mjs --check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check && git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
scripts.verify:marketplaces: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- uv run --locked tools/verify_marketplaces.py
scripts.verify: npm run check:python && npm run check:source && npm run check:docs && npm run docs:check && npm run check:evals && npm test && npm run verify:marketplaces
scripts.check:python: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- uv run --locked tools/check.py
scripts.check:release: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- uv run --locked python -m tools.release_version check
scripts.check:docs: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- sh -c "slopsentral-docs check && slopsentral-site check"
scripts.docs:check: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- uv run --locked tools/ci.py docs
scripts.docs:dev: python3 tools/toolchain.py run -- uv run --locked tools/ci.py preview
